en.headline: 14 own commits across 2 repos, 3 issues on anomalyco/opencode, 1 discussion
en.summary: On 2026-10-16 the user logged **14 own commits** across two repositories, plus 18 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` on `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` (7 commits) the work was documentation-heavy: adding `AGENTS.md`, introducing a `knowledge/` base for Git & GitHub findings with Excalidraw sketches, generalizing the knowledge scope beyond Git/GitHub, archiving OpenCode V2 distribution/architecture/auth notes plus Windows path pitfalls, archiving oh-my-opencode-slim and hosted OpenCode field notes, and making knowledge supplementation a default action with architecture allowed to adapt. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` (7 commits) the user added a `--force` flag to the daily CLI to skip the comment-count snapshot freeze and explained the backfill effect on re-running closed dates, shipped a new 30-day GitHub activity AI summary (home card plus standalone page), fixed `--force` to also re-fetch the finalized day's comment snapshot, stopped filtering candidate entries by whether `updated_at` fell inside the window, extracted `lib/days.mjs` as a shared helper to generalize the AI-generation entry point, tightened comment-count semantics and target lookup per review feedback, and fixed a +08 early-morning reply-collection gap while surfacing comment counts on Issue/PR rows.

zh.headline: 14 次本人提交覆盖 2 个仓库，anomalyco/opencode 上 3 个 issue，新开 1 个讨论
zh.summary: 2026-10-16 当天，用户在两个仓库共提交 **14 次本人提交**，另有 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 上由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交的 18 次。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`（7 次）以文档工作为主：新增 `AGENTS.md`，建立 `knowledge/` 目录归档 Git & GitHub 相关发现并附 Excalidraw 草图，将 knowledge 范围从 Git/GitHub 泛化为「各种知识」，归档 OpenCode V2 分发/架构/认证与 Windows 路径坑，归档 oh-my-opencode-slim 与托管 OpenCode 实测知识，并把 knowledge 补充改为默认动作、允许架构随内容调整。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`（7 次）中，用户为 daily CLI 增加 `--force` 参数以跳过评论数快照冻结并说明重跑已关闭日期的补录效应，新增近 30 天 GitHub 活动 AI 总结（首页卡片 + 独立页），修复 `--force` 一并重取定稿日评论数快照，取消按 `updated_at` 是否落在窗口内过滤候选条目，抽出 `lib/days.mjs` 共享助手以通用化 AI 生成入口，按复审意见收紧评论数口径与 target 检索，并修复 +08 凌晨漏采回复、在 Issue/PR 行显示评论数。在 `anomalyco/opencode` 上，用户新开 issue `#55785`（"go: mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects every image (400)"）和 `#55772`（"[FEATURE]: Windows desktop ships the CLI but there is no way to run it"），并在 `#55785` 上追加评论；`opencode-agent[bot]` 在两个 issue 上均有回复，`micahgerges` 在 `#55785` 上给出了受控 2×2 复现。此外，`Tarquinen` 关闭了 `anomalyco/opencode#51263`（"websearch: tinyfish provider returns HTTP 400 (missing Mcp-Session-Id) on every search"）。用户还在 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 Ideas 分类下新开讨论 `#4982` "Share session archive state with OpenCode's own clients"。当天无 PR、无 review、无 release，各采集分区均未触及上限。
